decision_summary: Core repository state, checkpoint immutability, corpus totals (1,258 docs, 245,758 tokens), lossless tokenizer roundtrip, and 150 vs 300 step regression metrics reproduce with 100% precision. Release readiness is CONDITIONAL due to validation split concentration (81.6% Hinglish) requiring macro-source loss weighting, checkpoint serialization requiring optimizer/RNG states, and residual MediaWiki markup in Sanskrit requiring pre-flight regex stripping.

gates.name: Repository State and Branch Lineage
gates.result: Branch dev/v0.6-v0.7-validation verified at HEAD b006c21. Preceding milestone deliverables cataloged and intact.
gates.limitations: Unrelated pre-existing working-tree changes preserved untouched per mission constraints.

gates.name: Canonical and Candidate Checkpoint Cryptographic Immutability
gates.result: Canonical checkpoint (96357705...), CPT 150-step (85753315...), and CPT 300-step (2f775151...) binary hashes match expected digests exactly.
gates.limitations: Checkpoints were evaluated on CPU without modifying weights.

gates.name: Corpus v2 Deterministic Reconciliation
gates.result: Exactly 1,258 documents, 245,758 tokens, 533,433 characters. 100% SHA-256 match per document and zero UTF-8 decode errors.
gates.limitations: Corpus size is 245k tokens, suited for targeted low-compute CPT.

gates.name: Source-Family Split Isolation and Leakage Audit
gates.result: Source families strictly disjoint across train/val/test. Zero exact document duplicates across splits. Zero cross-split whitespace 8-gram leakage.
gates.limitations: Normalized regex 8-grams show 7 standard functional phrase overlaps (e.g., 'defined as', 'natural science') between train and val, but zero narrative leakage.

gates.name: Sanskrit and Hinglish Extraction Quality
gates.result: Sanskrit raw extraction contains 184 wiki quote markups and 45 indentation colons impacting 49.2% of Sanskrit documents. Hinglish dataset concatenates short queries into artificial paragraph transitions.
gates.limitations: Documents are linguistically authentic but contain extraction formatting artifacts.
gates.remediation: Execute pre-flight regex stripping on Sanskrit markup before running Phase 5 training.

gates.name: Corpus-Wide Multilingual Tokenizer Reproduction
gates.result: Evaluated all 1,258 documents. Lossless roundtrip is 100.0%. Mean tokens/word: Hinglish 2.244, English 2.804, Hindi 3.050, Sanskrit 6.168, Code 2.888. Context budget implications analyzed.
gates.limitations: Sanskrit and Hinglish rely on 1 source family each.
gates.remediation: None required for current milestone; maintain canonical vocab_4096.

gates.name: Direct 150-Step vs 300-Step Comparison Reproduction
gates.result: Token-weighted delta +0.1178 CE (95% CI [+0.0858, +0.1521]), macro delta +0.1324 CE (95% CI [+0.1050, +0.1609]), source-clustered 95% CI [+0.0494, +0.2174], analytical paired t-stat 9.1558 (p < 1e-13). Discrepancy between B=2000 and B=10000 explained.
gates.remediation: Clerical token-count typo (3,363 vs 11,022) documented and clarified.

gates.name: Validation Split Concentration and Checkpoint Selection
gates.result: Validation split has only 3 source families, with Hinglish comprising 81.57% of validation tokens, threatening checkpoint selection bias.
gates.limitations: Raw token-weighted validation loss would reflect predominantly Hinglish performance.
gates.remediation: Mandate equal-weighted macro-source validation loss (1/3 Hinglish, 1/3 Ganit, 1/3 Bisect) for early-stopping and checkpoint selection.

gates.name: CPT Training Engine Resume and RNG State Handling
gates.result: Training plan defines AdamW, cosine schedule, warmup, batch size, seeds (42, 1337, 2026), and loss thresholds. However, previous script only saved model state dict, lacking optimizer and RNG state recovery.
gates.limitations: CPT script needs enhanced state serialization for mid-run recovery.
gates.remediation: Update training runner checkpoint save function to serialize optimizer_state, scheduler_state, and rng_state.

gates.name: Test Benchmark Blinding and Downstream Transfer Probes
gates.result: Test split is strictly blinded from training. Downstream deterministic transfer probes (arithmetic, AST python parsing, factual cloze) are pre-registered to separate neural learning from tooling.
gates.limitations: Probes will be executed only after checkpoint freeze in future milestone.
